## About Shanghai Ryu Medical Co., Ltd.

Shanghai Ryu Medical Co., Ltd. is one of the professional suppliers for Medical Instrument products
in China. Our dedicated team carries more than 10 years of hands-on experience in the medical field,
making us a reliable and knowledgeable partner for healthcare procurement worldwide.

We are a factory located in Jiangsu Province, strategically positioned near Shanghai Port — ensuring
fast, efficient, and cost-effective global logistics. Our core manufacturing capabilities cover
syringes, infusion sets, gloves, and face masks, all produced under rigorous quality control
standards.

In order to fulfill the increasing needs of our trusted and loyal customers, apart from our own
factory, we have established partnerships with more than 5 strategic partners who produce urine
bags, surgical gowns, medical tubes, wound dressings, syringes, diagnostics, and lab products —
giving you a comprehensive one-stop sourcing solution.

[Shanghai Ryu Medical Factory - Professional Medical Instrument Supplier in China]

## Our Core Medical Products

We manufacture and supply a comprehensive range of high-quality disposable medical products, all
meeting international CE & ISO standards for safety and reliability.

💉

### Syringes

Precision-manufactured disposable syringes in multiple sizes, designed for safe and accurate
medication delivery in clinical and hospital settings.

🩺

### Infusion Sets

High-quality IV infusion sets engineered for smooth fluid delivery, compatible with standard IV bags
and bottles across healthcare environments.

🧤

### Medical Gloves

Latex, nitrile, and vinyl examination gloves offering excellent protection, tactile sensitivity, and
comfort for medical professionals.

😷

### Face Masks

Surgical and protective face masks with multi-layer filtration, providing reliable barrier
protection against airborne particles and contaminants.

## Extended Product Range via Strategic Partners

Beyond our factory output, our 5+ vetted strategic partners expand our product portfolio to cover
your complete medical supply needs — all under our quality supervision.

## Our Quality Assurance System

We care deeply about the success of our customers. We understand that quality is the foundation of
trust — which is why we have built a rigorous, multi-layered quality control framework.

🏗️

### Dedicated QC Team on Production Lines

We have established a strong, dedicated Quality Control team stationed directly on different
production lines. This real-time oversight ensures every product meets our strict internal standards
before it ever reaches our customers.

🔍

### Multi-Stage Inspection Process

Every product batch undergoes incoming material inspection, in-process quality checks, and final
pre-shipment inspection. Our systematic approach minimizes defect rates and guarantees consistency
across every order.

📋

### Full Documentation & Traceability

We maintain complete production records and batch traceability for all products. Our documentation
system ensures full transparency and compliance, supporting your regulatory requirements in any
market worldwide.

## Internationally Recognized Certifications

Our company is approved by CE & ISO certificates for most of our products — demonstrating our
unwavering commitment to international medical device safety standards and regulatory compliance.

## Monitoring Manufacturer

**Shenzhen Ocent Monitor Co., Ltd.** is a technology-driven manufacturer specializing in remote
patient monitoring systems, telehealth monitoring solutions, and digital healthcare technologies.
Established in **2016**, the company is headquartered in Shenzhen, China, one of the world's leading
innovation and electronics manufacturing hubs.

With a modern production facility covering more than **8,000 square meters** and a workforce of over
**180 employees**, Ocent Monitor focuses on the design, development, and manufacturing of
intelligent healthcare monitoring solutions for hospitals, clinics, long-term care facilities, and
home healthcare providers worldwide.

Supported by an experienced engineering team and rigorous quality management processes, the company
maintains strict production standards throughout product development and manufacturing. Ocent
Monitor is committed to continuous innovation in connected healthcare technologies, enabling
healthcare professionals to access real-time patient information and make informed clinical
decisions.

This review examines how microscopy and computational analysis can identify defects in
self-assembled nanosphere structures used in photonics, sensing, coatings, drug delivery, and
nanosphere lithography. It concludes that multimodal imaging, standardized datasets, and
data-efficient machine learning could improve quantitative inspection and feedback-guided assembly.

## Creative Gas Detection Solutions

ENMET has been providing quality toxic gas detection equipment for over 50 years. ENMET specializes
in [medical air, environmental, and industrial health and safety monitoring instruments][44]. Our
Products include compressed airline monitors and portable breathing air systems, continuous
multi-channel fixed systems, and [autonomous gas chromatographic monitoring systems][45] for
facility, fence line, and community monitoring of toxic chemicals at trace levels.

We provide expert technical assistance, including problem assessment and product selection, as well
as advice on system installation and training.

cGMP CRDMO


cGMP-integrated contract research, development, and manufacturing organization. Esco Aster operates
two dedicated certified sites: one focused on clinical medicine, veterinary medicine, and
dermocosmetics; the other focused on clinical cell-based and derivative nutrition, and
nutricosmetics.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][66]

Advancing the Future of Medicine Through Innovation


At Esco Aster, we empower the development of next-generation medicines by combining advanced
bioprocess solutions, translational research, and scalable manufacturing support. From discovery to
commercialization, we help innovators accelerate breakthroughs in biologics, cell and gene therapy,
vaccines, and regenerative medicine.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][67]

Enabling Next-Generation Clinical Nutritional Solutions


Esco Aster provides cell-based products and derivatives for clinical and functional nutrition. These
include cell-based meats, proteins, fatty acids, collagen, and other high-value ingredients such as
bird’s nest, deer antler, mitochondria, and milk-/plant-derived extracellular vesicles for
nutraceuticals and supplements.

These products are developed for both companion animals and humans, ensuring clinical benefits for
improved skin health and gut microbiome function. This enables precision nutrition for cancer
patients as well as wellness and longevity applications aimed at increasing health span, not just
lifespan.

dermocosmetics; the other focused on clinical cell-based and derivative nutrition, and
nutricosmetics.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][66]

Advancing the Future of Medicine Through Innovation


At Esco Aster, we empower the development of next-generation medicines by combining advanced
bioprocess solutions, translational research, and scalable manufacturing support. From discovery to
commercialization, we help innovators accelerate breakthroughs in biologics, cell and gene therapy,
vaccines, and regenerative medicine.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][67]

Enabling Next-Generation Clinical Nutritional Solutions


Esco Aster provides cell-based products and derivatives for clinical and functional nutrition. These
include cell-based meats, proteins, fatty acids, collagen, and other high-value ingredients such as
bird’s nest, deer antler, mitochondria, and milk-/plant-derived extracellular vesicles for
nutraceuticals and supplements.

These products are developed for both companion animals and humans, ensuring clinical benefits for
improved skin health and gut microbiome function. This enables precision nutrition for cancer
patients as well as wellness and longevity applications aimed at increasing health span, not just
lifespan.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][68]

Enterprise Solution


Esco Aster’s Enterprise Solutions offer a vertically integrated, one-stop framework for the
specialized design, construction, and validation of world-class life science and healthcare
facilities

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][69]

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One

# Empowering working people and our communities for a better life

## Join E tū

Become an E tū union member today quickly and easily. We can use our power together to improve our
working lives.

[Join Today][46]

## E tū Campaigns

[Learn More][47]
* ### [Transforming Care – Pay Equity][48]
  
  E tū’s Transforming Care campaign unites workers, unions, and communities in the fight for pay
  equity, safe staffing, and a funding model that values people over profit.
  
  [Learn more about Transforming Care][49]
* ### [Decent Work][50]
  
  E tū’s Decent Work campaign unites workers to secure fair pay, job security, and safe, dignified
  workplaces, anchored in our Decent Work Charter and the four pillars of a fairer future.
  
  [Learn more about Decent Work][51]
* ### [Living Wage ][52]
  
  E tū champions the Living Wage campaign, uniting workers and communities to secure fair pay and
  decent conditions for all.
  
  [Learn more about Living Wage][53]
* ### [Just Transition][54]
  
  E tū supports a Just Transition to manage rapid industry change as the economy shifts to meet
  climate commitments.
  
  [Learn more about Just Transition][55]

**Operating Room Quality Respiratory Data at the Patient Bedside**

#### Every Breath Counts®

Linshom Medical is the **first **to deliver a wearable, FDA-cleared, operating room quality
respiratory profile to the patient’s bedside. This provides early warning of respiratory problems
and may help avoid costly rapid response activations, rescue events (codes), ICU transfers and
deaths. 

[Learn More][34]

## Mission

 

### **We intend to eliminate the morbidity‭, ‬mortality‭, ‬and expense due to unrecognized respiratory
### decline in healthcare.‬**

#### Why is respiratory monitoring important?

 Adequate ventilation is an important concern for patients and physicians in many situations and
environments. Patients often exhibit depressed respiration following surgery, as a result of
post-surgical pain, sedation secondary to analgesic medications, ineffective airway clearance, or
impaired gas exchange. The Linshom Medical Continuous Predictive Respiratory Monitor (CPRM) is
capable of non-invasively and portably measuring Respiratory Rate (RR), Seconds Since Last Breath
(SSLB), and trend of Relative Tidal Volume in patients with an oxygen mask.

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

Founded in 2015, Pinnacle Life Science leverages its rich heritage (Aarti Group) to deliver
high-quality medications across diverse therapeutic areas. Our state-of-the-art manufacturing
produces billions of tablets and capsules annually, supplying a global network of partners in over
90 countries.

With a commitment to innovation and excellence, we continuously invest in advanced technologies and
stringent quality control measures to ensure the highest safety and efficacy standards. Our
dedicated team of experts works tirelessly to bring cutting-edge solutions to patients worldwide,
making us a trusted name in the pharmaceutical industry.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

# empowering Qare. anywhere. always.


advancing healthcare through connected care — providing real-time insights, supporting caregivers in
their decisions, and improving patient outcomes.



[ contact us ][23]

## smarter patient monitoring. simplified.

smartQare simplifies patient monitoring by replacing spot-checks, multiple devices, and complex
setups with one continuous, real-time solution. It supports more efficient workflows, reduces
complexity, and helps caregivers respond at the right moment with clear, reliable insights.
* [ [in-hospital monitoring] ][24]
* [ [hospital-to-home monitoring] ][25]
* [ [home monitoring] ][26]
* [ [in-hospital monitoring] ][27]
  
  ### [ in-hospital monitoring ][28]
  
  Spot checks on general wards can leave critical gaps in patient tracking and increase nurse
  workloads. smartQare’s continuous monitoring solutions provide real-time insights, improving
  patient safety and giving nurses time back to focus on direct care.
* [ [hospital-to-home monitoring] ][29]
  
  ### [ hospital-to-home monitoring ][30]
  
  Postoperative recovery requires close monitoring to detect complications early. smartQare makes it
  easy to track patients remotely as they transition from hospital to home, ensuring safety,
  supporting recovery, early discharge, reduction of average hospital stays, and even readmissions.
* [ [home monitoring] ][31]
  
  ### [ home monitoring ][32]
  
  smartQare’s solutions provide continuous care for individuals at home, whether recovering from
  illness, managing chronic conditions, or maintaining general health. viQtor monitors vital signs,
  activity, and falls, providing comfort and safety, while giving caregivers valuable insights for
  better care.

news flash

## viQtor powers one of Europe’s largest hospital@home initiatives

smartQare technology will enable continuous remote patient monitoring across the Region Stockholm
for the hospital@home program led by Karolinska University Hospital.

Up to 15,000 patients will benefit annually from connected, hospital-level care at home through
real-time wearable monitoring.


[Discover the Karolinska initiative][33]

[viQtor powers one of Europe’s largest hospital@home initiatives]

## Discovery Health has chosen viQtor

Proud that smartQare is supporting the **Discovery Care at Home programme** in South Africa together
with [Cuviva AB][34] and [AIRO Health Care][35].


Discovery Health is South Africa’s largest medical scheme administrator and managed care provider,
accounting for 38.3% of the total membership of South African medical schemes, with a membership
base of approximately 2.7 million.




[Read about Discovery's Care at Home Programme][36]




[Link to Discovery's press release][37]

[Discovery Health has chosen viQtor]

## Strategic Partnership Announcement

In response to growing pressure on healthcare systems worldwide, **Cuviva** and **smartQare** today
announced a strategic partnership aimed at transforming how patients are monitored and cared for at
home, particularly in the critical period following hospital discharge.



[Read about the partnership][38]

[Strategic Partnership Announcement]

## [the growing challenges in healthcare][39]

Healthcare systems are under growing pressure from an aging population, workforce shortages, and
rising costs. Care teams are supporting more patients with increasingly complex needs, often with
limited time and resources, leading to higher workloads and strain.

At the same time, the need to make timely, well-informed decisions based on patient data is
increasing. This adds complexity to daily care delivery and can affect both care quality and
operational efficiency. In this environment, there is a clear need for smarter, more supportive
approaches that enable consistent, confident, and timely care.

## PRESSURE – Advancing Remote Cardiovascular Care Beyond the Hospital

PRESSURE (Personal HypErtenSion and Cardiovascular CaRE) is a collaborative innovation project
focused on advancing remote patient monitoring for cardiovascular care. This joint initiative brings
together smartQare,  FreeSenseSolutions, TU/e (EAISI), Catharina Hospital, and Eurocept Homecare,
with support from OPZuid, the European Union, and the Province of North Brabant.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

**Operating Room Quality Respiratory Data at the Patient Bedside**

#### Every Breath Counts®

Linshom Medical is the **first **to deliver a wearable, FDA-cleared, operating room quality
respiratory profile to the patient’s bedside. This provides early warning of respiratory problems
and may help avoid costly rapid response activations, rescue events (codes), ICU transfers and
deaths. 

[Learn More][34]

## Mission

 

### **We intend to eliminate the morbidity‭, ‬mortality‭, ‬and expense due to unrecognized respiratory
### decline in healthcare.‬**

 

## Recent News & Publications

#### About Us

[Meet the Team][35]

#### Why is respiratory monitoring important?

 Adequate ventilation is an important concern for patients and physicians in many situations and
environments. Patients often exhibit depressed respiration following surgery, as a result of
post-surgical pain, sedation secondary to analgesic medications, ineffective airway clearance, or
impaired gas exchange. The Linshom Medical Continuous Predictive Respiratory Monitor (CPRM) is
capable of non-invasively and portably measuring Respiratory Rate (RR), Seconds Since Last Breath
(SSLB), and trend of Relative Tidal Volume in patients with an oxygen mask.

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [

  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]

  ][55]

  ][56]

  ][57]

# empowering Qare. anywhere. always.


advancing healthcare through connected care — providing real-time insights, supporting caregivers in
their decisions, and improving patient outcomes.



[ contact us ][23]

## smarter patient monitoring. simplified.

smartQare simplifies patient monitoring by replacing spot-checks, multiple devices, and complex
setups with one continuous, real-time solution. It supports more efficient workflows, reduces
complexity, and helps caregivers respond at the right moment with clear, reliable insights.
* [ [in-hospital monitoring] ][24]
* [ [hospital-to-home monitoring] ][25]
* [ [home monitoring] ][26]
* [ [in-hospital monitoring] ][27]
  
  ### [ in-hospital monitoring ][28]
  
  Spot checks on general wards can leave critical gaps in patient tracking and increase nurse
  workloads. smartQare’s continuous monitoring solutions provide real-time insights, improving
  patient safety and giving nurses time back to focus on direct care.
* [ [hospital-to-home monitoring] ][29]
  
  ### [ hospital-to-home monitoring ][30]
  
  Postoperative recovery requires close monitoring to detect complications early. smartQare makes it
  easy to track patients remotely as they transition from hospital to home, ensuring safety,
  supporting recovery, early discharge, reduction of average hospital stays, and even readmissions.
* [ [home monitoring] ][31]
  
  ### [ home monitoring ][32]
  
  smartQare’s solutions provide continuous care for individuals at home, whether recovering from
  illness, managing chronic conditions, or maintaining general health. viQtor monitors vital signs,
  activity, and falls, providing comfort and safety, while giving caregivers valuable insights for
  better care.

news flash

## viQtor powers one of Europe’s largest hospital@home initiatives

smartQare technology will enable continuous remote patient monitoring across the Region Stockholm
for the hospital@home program led by Karolinska University Hospital.

Up to 15,000 patients will benefit annually from connected, hospital-level care at home through
real-time wearable monitoring.


[Discover the Karolinska initiative][33]

[viQtor powers one of Europe’s largest hospital@home initiatives]

## Discovery Health has chosen viQtor

Proud that smartQare is supporting the **Discovery Care at Home programme** in South Africa together
with [Cuviva AB][34] and [AIRO Health Care][35].


Discovery Health is South Africa’s largest medical scheme administrator and managed care provider,
accounting for 38.3% of the total membership of South African medical schemes, with a membership
base of approximately 2.7 million.




[Read about Discovery's Care at Home Programme][36]




[Link to Discovery's press release][37]

In response to growing pressure on healthcare systems worldwide, **Cuviva** and **smartQare** today
announced a strategic partnership aimed at transforming how patients are monitored and cared for at
home, particularly in the critical period following hospital discharge.



[Read about the partnership][38]

## [the growing challenges in healthcare][39]

Healthcare systems are under growing pressure from an aging population, workforce shortages, and
rising costs. Care teams are supporting more patients with increasingly complex needs, often with
limited time and resources, leading to higher workloads and strain.

At the same time, the need to make timely, well-informed decisions based on patient data is
increasing. This adds complexity to daily care delivery and can affect both care quality and
operational efficiency. In this environment, there is a clear need for smarter, more supportive
approaches that enable consistent, confident, and timely care.
